_read_me: Sign-in configuration for this deployment. Every value is null out of the box, which is the honest default: a static copy of these pages verifies nobody, so with nothing configured the sign-in dialog offers only a device passkey and a wallet signature. Fill in the values your host actually operates and nothing else — WebXR/shared/auth.js never contacts an endpoint that is null here. See docs/sign-in.md. mapboxToken is read by WebXR/shared/mapbox.js (the Bay Atlas and Bay World's satellite ground) and must be a Mapbox *public* token or null; with null nothing is ever requested from Mapbox. See docs/mapbox.md. guideConfig.endpoint is read by WebXR/shared/guide.js: null (the default) keeps every Guide answer on this device; set it to an https URL of a service you operate and the Guide posts the question with the chunks it retrieved there and shows the reply. Never put a key here.

enterprise._read_me: The organisation layer (docs/enterprise.md). null everywhere means the public platform: every sign-in method, every world and programme, English until the visitor picks a language. A deployment for one organisation fills these in; the homepage, the sign-in dialog and the instructor console honour them. Nothing here is read from the launch URL. sso is a note for the deployment's own identity provider — no vendor is named or implemented here; a real provider is wired through the host page (docs/sign-in.md, 'What reaches the host page').
enterprise.dataRetention: Everything a person does stays in the browser that recorded it (localStorage under a per-person namespace; the free demo uses sessionStorage and ends with the tab). Nothing leaves the device without an explicit export or an opt-in. A deployment states its own retention period for exported files here.

sso.note: Single sign-on is a configuration point, not a feature of these static pages: the host page that embeds them verifies the credential and passes the learner through the existing launch context (?learner=, ?learner_id=, ?learner_home=) or the smartcitix:identity message. Fill in signInMethods to hide the methods the organisation does not use.
